thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: SEV2 — sustained 5xx spike on /v1/complete in us-west-2 (approx +4.7% error rate over baseline). Auto-scaler firing. Pager: Samir.
Samir: I'm on call — joining bridge now. Can someone post the quick symptom summary?
Tara: seeing a pattern: KV prefix cache misses are up, then a burst of KVCACHE 503s -> downstream OOMs in the small-model pool.
Kevin: confirming, logs show frequent 'kvstore: missing prefix' followed by repeated reopen attempts. Snippet: ```ERROR kvcache.go:142 prefix miss for model:redwood-llm-small```
Morgan: traffic sketch — tail latency up from 120ms -> 1.2s for ~6% of requests, 5xxs concentrated on multi-turn chat endpoints.
Samir: first mitigation: disabling small-model pool autoscale step to prevent rapid churn. Running: ```kubectl patch hpa inference-small -n us-west --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/behavior","value":null}]'``` will hold replicas steady. Doing now.
ops-bot: Action logged: autoscale hold applied by Samir at 1799990015.
Samir: applied hold, monitoring. Also routing 30% of chat traffic to fallback medium-model (less memory pressure) with runtime flag flip: `route.policy=steady-fallback:0.3`
Tara: after routing shift, error rate dropped to ~1.1% but latency still elevated for some requests. Looks like KV cache rebuild is hot.
Kevin: investigating recent runtime change from last deploy (2026-03-09) that changed prefix eviction heuristics. Rolling that change back on a fraction of hosts. Rolling command: ```for node in $(kubectl get nodes -l pool=small -o name); do kubectl annotate $node rollback-evic=true; done```
Morgan: customer-impact quick summary for comms: 3 customers reported increased errors, 1 dedicated customer saw 10% of requests rate-limited by internal throttles. No data exfiltration.
Elaine: flagging Customer Success — prepping outbound note draft. Will coordinate content after postmortem consensus.
Samir: rollback to old eviction heuristics in progress — observing gradual error decline. Will keep autoscale hold until KVCACHE warm.
ops-bot: Deploy rollback started by Samir at 1799990180.
Tara: confirm that KVS snapshot restore helped one host recover; we should consider pre-warming prefix cache on rollout.
Kevin: agreed. Immediate follow-ups: 1) Finish rollback; 2) Increase small-pool steady capacity by +20% for the next 2 hours; 3) Add a short-term prefix warm job. Implementing #2 now.
Samir: finished scaling steady capacity +20% at 1799990305. Error rate ~0.35% now.
Morgan: Customer impact: Estimated request failures ~0.8% of traffic during the peak window (1799990000-1799990300). Affected features: multi-turn chat and long-context completion. Only customers on small-model pool affected.
Tara: routing logs and samples saved under s3://rwdn-ops/incident-1799990000/ for postmortem.
Samir: declaring containment at 1799990320 — baseline restored and autoscale hold will be removed after a 30m steady window.
ops-bot: Containment recorded by Samir at 1799990320. Incident severity status: SEV2 -> Contained.
Elaine: Proposed post-incident follow-ups: - schedule postmortem (1hr) in next 48h - create action items ticket INC-2026-310 and link to rollout PR - org brown-bag on prefix/caching patterns next week
Kevin: I'll create INC-2026-310 with short summary + action items. Assigned: Kevin (root cause deep-dive), Tara (pre-warm automation), Samir (playbook update), Morgan (customer comms). ETA: 2026-03-19 for initial RCA draft.
Kevin: Created INC-2026-310: https://issues.redwood/INC-2026-310 — please leave comments and add logs you pulled.
Tara: action: pre-warm job prototype pushed to infra branch; will open PR and link to ticket by end of day.
Samir: playbook note: add a checklist entry to confirm prefix-cache warm after any prefix-affecting runtime change; I'll update runbook after RCA.
Morgan: customer comms draft ready for review. Elaine can sign off, then I'll send targeted notes to the three affected customers.
Elaine: schedule: postmortem 2026-03-18 16:00 PT (60m). Can everyone make that?
Samir: yes.
Tara: yes.
Kevin: yes.
Morgan: yes.
Elaine: also proposing an org-wide brown-bag: 'Prefix cache patterns & rollout safety' — 45m + Q&A on 2026-03-24 11:00 PT. Will reserve L1 conference room + Zoom.
Samir: +1, will present mitigation timeline and playbook updates.
Tara: I'll cover the pre-warm automation design and demo.
Kevin: I'll present telemetry improvements and a sample kpis dashboard for KVCACHE health.
ops-bot: Follow-ups created: INC-2026-310 (RCA & remediation), TASK-2026-442 (pre-warm job PR), TASK-2026-443 (playbook update), COMM-2026-55 (customer outreach).
Elaine: assigning owners in ticket and adding link to calendar invites.
Samir: retrospective note — consider adding a capacity cushion/expedited warm path for any eviction algorithm change.
Tara: +1. Also add a test harness scenario that simulates prefix churn during rollout.
Kevin: closing log: containment sustained for 30m, autoscale hold removed at 1799990420, monitoring continues.
ops-bot: Autoscale hold removed at 1799990420 by Samir. Monitoring alert suppressed for this incident.
Morgan: thanks team — good containment. We'll surface learnings in the postmortem and brown-bag.
Elaine: Thanks everyone. I'll post the postmortem agenda and invite links in this thread once created.
